item.description: CARBONDALE, Ill., (KBSI) — Two juveniles reported missing in Carbondale have been located and returned home, according to the City of Carbondale Police Department. item.title: Perry County School District #32 central office returning to campus after tornado relocation
item.description: PERRYVILLE, Mo., (KBSI) — The Perry County School District 32 Central Administrative Office will return to campus nearly a year after being displaced by the March 2025 tornado. Beginning Monday, March 9, the Central Office will operate from the lower level of the Perryville Primary Center. item.title: Melissa Combs named Kennett City Administrator, begins role March 9
item.description: KENNETT, Mo., (KBSI) — The City of Kennett has hired Melissa Combs as its new city administrator. She will begin the role March 9, succeeding interim City Administrator Steve Rasmussen. Combs brings more than a decade of experience in economic development and public administration, including work in business recruitment, grant writing and administration, public-private partnerships and organizational leadership.
